notes: Dev ABox revision on executed_in (chains through located_in): Joan of Arc's execution moves from Rouen to Kyoto, counterfactual on purpose so every derived answer changes. Derived: the continent (chain, answer), the official currency in the city (composition) and a binding through the French peasant girl who lifted the siege of Orléans in 1429. The related question is the stored country of her execution ('burned at the stake in Rouen, France', 172 and 267 hits), moved to Japan through the bridge 'Kyoto is in Japan'; it is labelled derivation chain (executed_in chains with located_in). No derived query asks the country, so the related question's fact is asked only there.
